## Summary

Describe the change and its motivation. Link related issues where applicable.

## Validation

Describe the tests or checks run and their results. For documentation-only changes,
describe the content and link checks instead.

## Compatibility and security

Describe any public API, configuration, Protobuf field numbering, or schema hash
changes. Include migration guidance when needed. For performance claims, specify
the baseline, identical requests, environment, and measurement method.

## Checklist

- [ ] I followed [CONTRIBUTING.md](https://github.com/develmax/DevelKit.GrpcEmbed/blob/main/CONTRIBUTING.md) and the [Code of Conduct](https://github.com/develmax/DevelKit.GrpcEmbed/blob/main/CODE_OF_CONDUCT.md).
- [ ] Relevant tests and documentation are updated, or I explained why they are not needed.
- [ ] Public contract changes include schema compatibility tests, if applicable.
- [ ] No credentials, personal data, or private configuration are included.
- [ ] Breaking changes and release-note requirements are identified, if applicable.
